text: FODEN SCORES! City's pressure finally pays off! It's a lovely scooped pass from Kovacic to Haaland, and Senesi is caught on the wrong side of the forward.
GOOD SAVE! Cook threads it into Solanke, who holds off Dias long enough to cushion the ball into Christie's path.
SAVE! Kerkez strays infield this time and squares it to Kluivert.
GREAT SAVE! Zabarnyi is sliding in to stop it from reaching Haaland, but he inadvertently helps it onto his toe.

narrative_context: late moment after a near miss
text: It skims the post on its way wide, and that was the chance!
WIDE! Ake goals long and Foden flicks a wonderful pass into Haaland's feet on the edge of the D.
GREAT SAVE! It's a great delivery from Christie on the corner, and Solanke gets away from his marker to thump a header on goal from the far post.
CHANCE! Solanke is picked out from a throw-in, and he does well to hold off Dias.
He gets his shot up and over the wall, but it curls wide of the far top corner.
Silva finds himself in a tight spot in the corner, but he turns away from his marker long enough to pick out Foden on the edge of the box.

narrative_context: sudden late moment with little build-up
text: CLOSE! Ouattara slides in with a brilliant tackle on Rodri and plays a one-two with Christie.
